subject: Launch Accelerator Map + Escalation Lanes for Meridian Labs
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Arielle Cohen <arielle@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Launch Accelerator Map + Escalation Lanes for Meridian Labs

Arielle — thanks again for the kickoff today. Attached is a first-pass Launch Accelerator MAP (Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx) that translates our mutual commitments into a week-by-week running plan. Highlights and asks below: 

Quick summary (top-of-doc):
- Goal: Production-ready Redwood inference pipelines for Meridian product search by 2026-10-01.
- Key milestones: Network provisioning (A), Model onboarding & quantization (B), End-to-end QA + user acceptance (C), Go-live & rollback plan (D).
- Primary owners: Meridian infra (Samir), Redwood implementation lead (Marissa), Redwood eng ops (Marcus).

Immediate asks:
1) Please confirm the Meridian-side owners for Network, Data Ingress, and Security evidence (I listed Samir for Network + Nik for Security).
2) Review the proposed week-by-week milestones in tab "90d MAP" — call out any immovable blackout dates or procurement gating items.
3) If the SOW payment milestone needs re-alignment with provisioning, flag now; we can shift the provisioning window by up to 7 business days without affecting the go-live target.

Escalation lanes (short):
- Level 1 (Operational): Marissa — 24/7 bridge during cutover windows.
- Level 2 (Engineering): Marcus — model/latency regressions and fallback policy owner.
- Level 3 (Executive): Priyom / Meridian exec sponsor — SLA exceptions and contract-level decisions.

I've also linked a working Drive folder for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aMeridianMAP.

Next step: Marissa, can you propose a 30/60/90 checklist with one-week checkpoints by EOD Monday? Arielle / Samir — if you can confirm owners and any procurement windows by Friday, we'll lock the MAP.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
pri yom@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Attachments: Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_diagram_v2.pdf (diagram), SOW_Meridian_Signed.pdf (signed SOW)

From: Arielle Cohen <arielle@meridianlabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Qureshi <samir.qu@meridianlabs.com>, Nik Patel <nik.patel@meridianlabs.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Accelerator Map + Escalation Lanes for Meridian Labs

Priyom — thanks for the draft. Quick notes after sync with Samir and Nik: 

1) Owners: Samir is confirmed for Network provisioning but requests that Redwood provide the full port/IP whitelist by 2026-08-18 to avoid a security review delay. Nik will be the security evidence lead but needs a SOC2 artifact and data-retention map from us by 2026-08-13.

2) Blackout window: Meridian has a planned product holiday from 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-16; we cannot do risky cutovers that week. Please ensure no model-switching or quantization experiments overlap that window.

3) Procurement gating: The billing PO is in flight but likely to be approved by 2026-08-20. If provisioning needs to happen before the PO clears, we need to confirm the finance contact for a temporary spend approval.

4) Quick ask: Can Redwood confirm expected per-token billing delta for multi-quantized vs float32 baseline for our 95th percentile latency targets? A short note is fine.

We'll review the MAP spreadsheet and return a redline on tab "90d MAP" later today. Appreciate the escalation lanes — please route SOC2 artifacts to Nik.

Thanks,
Arielle
Head of Data Platform | Meridian Labs
arielle@meridianlabs.com

On Mon, Aug 9, 2026 at 09:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com> wrote:
> (original message and attachments)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Meridian MAP — immediate coordination and owner actions

Team — forwarding Arielle's asks. Action items below (short timeframe):

1) Marissa: build the 30/60/90 checklist as requested. Make explicit week-by-week owners for the first 6 weeks and add a "sign-off" row for Meridian UAT on each sprint boundary. Due: 2026-08-11 10:00am PT.
2) Marcus: prepare a short note (one page) comparing per-token cost / expected latency delta for: float32 baseline, int8 8-bit, and Q4 4-bit profile for the two candidate models listed in the MAP. Include recommended default for the go-live profile. Due: 2026-08-12 EOD PT.
3) Irene: pull SOC2 artifact summary and the retention/evidence checklist; put in the Drive folder and ping Nik. Due: 2026-08-13 noon PT.

Also: Meridian's blackout week 2026-09-10 -> 2026-09-16 must be treated as immutable. We'll schedule the go/no-go dry-run for 2026-09-24. Confirm availability for a 90-minute bridge on that date.

Escalation playbook (internal notes):
- If we hit a procurement stall >14 days beyond the PO expectation, escalate to Sales Ops and get funding contact looped.
- If latency regressions exceed the 95th percentile SLA by >150% during UAT, flip to fallback model and engage Marcus + infra.

Thanks — I'll join the first 30-min alignment tomorrow at 09:30 PT.

--
Priyom

> On 2026-08-10 Arielle wrote: (see earlier)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Arielle Cohen <arielle@meridianlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T16:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Launch Accelerator Map + Escalation Lanes for Meridian Labs — 30/60/90 checklist

Priyom / Arielle — attaching the 30_60_90_checklist tab in the MAP (uploaded to Drive). Highlights below and a condensed timeline: 

Week 0 (2026-08-16 to 2026-08-22):
- Owner: Marissa (Redwood) / Samir (Meridian)
- Tasks: Port/IP whitelist delivered (Samir); Provisioning slot reserved; Initial model artifact transfer; Security kickoff.
- Gate: Meridian confirms network allowlist and finance temporary approval if PO pending.

Week 2 (2026-08-30 to 2026-09-05):
- Owner: Marcus
- Tasks: Quantization experiments; Latency profiling (95th pct targets); Fallback variant tested.
- Gate: Latency within 1.5x baseline or fallback path validated.

Week 4 (2026-09-13 to 2026-09-19) — note we avoid 9/10–9/16 blackout:
- Owner: Marissa
- Tasks: UAT with Meridian product team; runbook rehearsal; bridge schedule confirmed.
- Gate: UAT sign-off (Meridian) and runbook checklist complete.

Week 6 (2026-09-27 to 2026-10-03):
- Owner: Marcus / Marissa
- Tasks: Go-live window; monitor 48h; rollback plan ready.
- Gate: Production monitoring show stable token error rates and latency within SLA.

Risks & mitigations (short):
- Risk: PO delay -> Mitigation: temporary finance approval + deploy limited-capacity reserved pool for smoke testing.
- Risk: SOC2 evidence lag -> Mitigation: Irene to provide minimal evidence bundle; escalate to Priyom for exec sign-off.

Arielle — confirmed owners (Samir for network, Nik for security) are reflected. Marcus, see the quantization task list — I've added two sample prompts Meridian asked we verify.

I'll host a 30-min checkpoint tomorrow (2026-08-13) at 09:30 PT to lock the Week 0 plan. Please confirm availability.

Thanks — Marissa
Customer Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments uploaded to Drive: 30_60_90_checklist (tab in Meridian_MAP_v1.xlsx)
